resources.string:
Health data stays under your control

Race Day Dreams can optionally read running exercise sessions and distance from Health Connect to show your recorded runs and help establish your current running baseline. Optional heart-rate access adds available heart-rate summaries. Optional history access, where supported, lets you review up to twelve weeks instead of the shorter standard access window.

Records retain their source and timestamps. Missing information stays unknown. Samsung Health and other platforms can contribute records when you have enabled their Health Connect synchronisation.

You can decline, grant only some permissions, or revoke them later. Manual baseline entry and the rest of the app remain available. Revoking permission stops new reads; previously imported records remain on this device until you choose Delete local data.

The app has no Internet permission, accounts, ads, analytics or server. Imported health records stay in private local storage and are excluded from backups. A backup includes your app-specific data and annotations and is written only to a destination you choose. That destination may be a cloud document provider if you select one.

Fitness guidance is not medical care. Recommendations are optional and no race outcome or injury prevention is guaranteed.
